title: Scoped instruction operation input
description: Inputs shared by generated scoped Markdown instruction operations.

target.description: Target repository path; defaults to the current directory.

name.description: Lowercase instruction identity used for scaffold creation.

paths.description: Repository-relative applicability patterns for a new instruction.

task.description: Optional task text used when explaining applicability.

changed.description: Changed or target paths used to evaluate applicability.

items.description: One repository-relative changed or target path.

verbose.description: Whether explanation output includes the compiled instruction program.

source.description: Repository-relative static instruction source used for migration advice.
